summary: packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts parsed legacy oauth.json without stripping a leading UTF-8 BOM, so JSON.parse threw, the error was swallowed by the surrounding try/catch, and the file was never migrated: OAuth credentials were lost and settings.json apiKeys silently won precedence. The oauth.json branch now decodes its content through the existing stripBom() helper (already used for settings.json/keybindings.json), which is the only production change.

changes.description: In migrateAuthToAuthJson(), the legacy oauth.json payload is now parsed as JSON.parse(stripBom(readFileSync(oauthPath, "utf-8"))) so a BOM-prefixed file migrates instead of throwing. No other behavior changed: settings.json apiKeys still fill in providers missing from oauth.json, OAuth entries still take precedence over apiKeys for the same provider, malformed files are still left untouched (still inside the same try/catch before renameSync), the oauth.json backup is still renamed to oauth.json.migrated only after a successful parse, and an existing auth.json still short-circuits the whole migration.

Standalone Node assertion script (node:assert/strict) that loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createGraph(), with the agent directory faked via a getAgentDir() binding and chalk/keybindings/config stubbed as boundaries; the real utils/text.ts is part of the graph. 7 cases: (1) BOM-prefixed oauth.json migrates to auth.json with type "oauth" + OAuth precedence over apiKeys + byte-identical oauth.json.migrated + apiKeys removed while other settings survive + idempotent re-run; (2) apiKey-only fallback; (3) BOM-prefixed settings.json apiKeys; (4) OAuth wins for the same provider; (5) malformed BOM oauth.json left in place with no auth.json created; (6) malformed oauth.json preserved while apiKeys still migrate; (7) existing auth.json/oauth.json/settings.json byte-for-byte untouched. Temp dirs are created under .prale-eval/ and removed in a finally block.

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0: all 7 regression tests passed, exit code 0. Fault sensitivity was verified by reverting only the production edit (JSON.parse(readFileSync(oauthPath, "utf-8"))): the script then failed with exit code 1 on the assertion 'OAuth credentials from the BOM-prefixed oauth.json must be preserved verbatim' (actual {type:'api_key',key:'sk-must-lose'} instead of the OAuth credential), and passed again after restoring the fix; the repository file was left in the fixed state (git diff shows the single stripBom line). Only stripTypeScriptTypes/VM-modules ExperimentalWarning messages are emitted; no timeouts, syntax or import errors. The harness has no external dependencies and performs no network access. Limitation: node_modules is absent in this workspace, so the repository's own vitest suite (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/credential-print.test.ts) could not be executed and no dependencies were installed; .prale-eval/regression.mjs is the focused validation artifact. No files outside the workspace were read or written, and TASK.md, subject.mjs, package locks and git config were left untouched.
